June 18, 2018 - By Henry Gaston
Philippe Laffont increased its stake in 3 (DDD) by 230.39% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Coatue Management Llc bought 670,179 shares as the company’s stock rose 15.80% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Philippe Laffont held 961,067 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $11.14M, up from 290,888 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Coatue Management Llc who had been investing in 3 for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $1.63 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.24% or $0.18 during the last trading session, reaching $14.29. About 2.05M shares traded. 3D Systems Corporation (NYSE:DDD) has declined 46.74% since June 18, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 59.31% the S&P500.
